knowledge:
- key_parameters: files=character vector of filenames to read ;; path=directory path where files are located ;; format=format of the input files (e.g., "SDS", "LightCycler", "CFX", "BioMark", "OpenArray") ;; n.features=number of features per sample/card ;; n.data=number of samples/data points per file ;; norm=normalization method ("quantile", "scale.rank", "norm.rank", "deltaCt", "geometric.mean") ;; deltaCt.genes=housekeeping genes used for deltaCt normalization ;; groups=experimental groups/conditions for plotting ;; calibrator=reference sample/group for relative Ct plotting ;; stratify=feature metadata column (e.g., "class", "type") to group by in plots ;; sample.order=vector defining layout splitting for multi-sample cards
- alternatives: None mentioned; the package integrates with and depends on Biobase, RColorBrewer, limma, statmod, affy, and gplots.
- when_to_use: When analyzing high-throughput qPCR assays (Ct or Cp values) across multiple conditions or replicates, including formats like TaqMan Low Density Arrays (TLDA), Roche LightCycler, Bio-Rad CFX, Fluidigm BioMark, and OpenArray.
- pitfalls: High variation between duplicates often occurs when one duplicate is "Undetermined" (artificially high Ct value) ;; Using exprs might be confusing for users unfamiliar with microarray data; getCt and setCt<- are provided as intuitive alternatives ;; Incorrectly specifying n.features and n.data for non-standard formats (like BioMark or OpenArray) will result in incorrect data dimensions.

workflows.name: standard_qpcr_analysis
workflows.intent: Import, quality control, normalize, visualize, and analyze standard qPCR Ct data.
input: files.txt (tab-delimited text file listing sample filenames and biological conditions)
sample1.txt (tab-delimited text file containing raw Ct values for sample 1)
workflows.stages: 1. Read sample info and raw Ct data ;; 2. Perform quality control and spatial layout visualization ;; 3. Assess replicate concordance and variation ;; 4. Filter and categorize Ct values ;; 5. Normalize Ct data ;; 6. Visualize normalized data distributions, correlations, and clustering
workflows.code:
files <- read.delim(file.path(path, "files.txt"))
raw <- readCtData(files = files$File, path = path)
g <- featureNames(raw)[1:10]
plotCtOverview(raw, genes = g, xlim = c(0, 50), groups = files$Treatment, conf.int = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 55))
plotCtOverview(raw, genes = g, xlim = c(0, 50), groups = files$Treatment, calibrator = "Control")
plotCtCard(raw, col.range = c(10, 35), well.size = 2.6)
featureClass(raw) <- factor(c("Marker", "TF", "Kinase")[sample(c(1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 3), 384, replace = TRUE)])
plotCtCard(raw, plot = "class", well.size = 2.6)
plotCtReps(qPCRraw, card = 2, percent = 20)
raw.mix <- raw
plotCtVariation(raw.mix, variation = "sd", log = TRUE, main = "SD of replicated features", col = "lightgrey")
raw.variation <- plotCtVariation(raw.mix, type = "detail", add.featurenames = TRUE, pch = " ", cex = 1.2)
raw.cat <- raw
plotCtCategory(raw.cat)
plotCtCategory(raw.cat, stratify = "class")
plotCtCategory(raw.cat, by.feature = TRUE, cexRow = 0.1)
q.norm <- normalizeCtData(raw.cat, norm = "quantile")
sr.norm <- normalizeCtData(raw.cat, norm = "scale.rank")
nr.norm <- normalizeCtData(raw.cat, norm = "norm.rank")
d.norm <- normalizeCtData(raw.cat, norm = "deltaCt", deltaCt.genes = c("Gene1", "Gene60"))
g.norm <- normalizeCtData(raw.cat, norm = "geometric.mean")
plotCtCor(raw, main = "Ct correlation")
plotCtDensity(sr.norm)
plotCtHistogram(sr.norm)
plotCtBoxes(sr.norm, stratify = "class")
plotCtScatter(sr.norm, cards = c(1, 2), col = "type", diag = TRUE)
plotCtPairs(sr.norm, col = "type", diag = TRUE)
plotCtHeatmap(raw, gene.names = "", dist = "euclidean")
plotCVBoxes(qPCRraw, stratify = "class")
clusterCt(sr.norm, type = "samples")
cluster.list <- clusterCt(sr.norm, type = "genes", n.cluster = 6, cex = 0.5)
plotCtPCA(qPCRraw)
getCtHistory(sr.norm)

workflows.name: alternative_platforms_import
workflows.intent: Import and reformat qPCR data from specialized platforms (SDS, LightCycler, CFX, BioMark, OpenArray).
workflows.stages: 1. Read raw data using platform-specific format and dimension parameters ;; 2. Reformat layout if multiple samples are on a single card ;; 3. Visualize spatial layout of microfluidic arrays
workflows.code:
raw <- readCtData(files="SDS_sample.txt", path=path, format="SDS")
raw <- readCtData(files="LightCycler_sample.txt", path=path, format="LightCycler")
raw <- readCtData(files="CFX_sample.txt", path=path, format="CFX", n.features=330)
raw1 <- readCtData(files="BioMark_sample.csv", path=exPath, format="BioMark", n.features=48, n.data=48)
plotCtArray(raw1)
raw1 <- readCtData(files="OpenArray_sample.csv", path=exPath, format="OpenArray", n.features=846, n.data=6)
sample2.order <- rep(c("subSampleA", "subSampleB"), each=192)
qPCRnew2 <- changeCtLayout(sr.norm, sample.order=sample2.order)
